I will do this bean plot the way I know and the way women around me do when money is tight. Last season I did not buy fertilizer, and I will not put my cash there this time too; I trust the farmyard manure I can gather at home more. I will plant my local seed, wait for the rains, and I will spray because insects can spoil beans fast here. My children and I will do most of the work, and I will only bring a few laborers when work is heavy.
